settings.heading: 1. Are gaming chairs only for gamers?
settings.content: No. Gaming chairs are designed for anyone who values comfort, support, and style. Whether you’re a professional working long hours, a student, or simply looking for a stylish and ergonomic chair, gaming chairs provide adjustable features and a durable design to enhance your everyday seating experience.

settings.heading: 2. What makes Blacklyte gaming chairs different from others?
settings.content: Blacklyte gaming chairs combine ergonomic design, premium materials, and esports-level performance. With high-density foam, sturdy steel frames, and adjustable support, our ergonomic gaming chairs provide lasting comfort for long gaming sessions or office work.

settings.heading: 3. Which Blacklyte gaming chair should I choose?
settings.content: If you want premium comfort and top-tier ergonomic design, go for Athena Pro. For a balanced combination of performance and value, choose Athena. For advanced ergonomics, upgraded materials, and pro-level performance, step up to the Kraken Pro.

settings.heading: 4. Do Blacklyte gaming chairs come with a warranty?
settings.content: Yes. All Blacklyte gaming chair comes with a standard 3-year warranty. For added protection, you can join our Extended Warranty Program to extend coverage by 2 more years and receive a €10 cashback.

settings.heading: 5. Do Blacklyte gaming chairs come with free shipping?
settings.content: Yes. All Blacklyte gaming chairs come with free shipping to most countries, so you can enjoy a hassle-free delivery right to your home.

settings.heading: 6. Can I return or exchange my gaming chair?
settings.content: Of course. We offer a 30-day free return and exchange policy to ensure you’re completely satisfied with your purchase.

settings.title: FAST FREE  SHIPPING
settings.text: Typically shipped within 1-2 business days, with delivery taking 3-5 days.

settings.title: 30-DAY EASY RETURNS
settings.text: You can easily return it within 30 days.

settings.title: LONGTIME WARRANTY
settings.text: Up to 5-year warranty. Lifetime technical support.
